name: Hidden Enemies
summary: Neeru Fireblade has earned your trust, and Thrall awaits your report in Orgrimmar. The Warchief needs to know how far the Burning Blade's reach extends across Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Cult Unveiled
sections.body: You carried a Lieutenant's Insignia from Skull Rock to Neeru Fireblade at Warchief Thrall's request. The warlock lives openly in the Cleft of Shadow. Later, you struck at the Searing Blade's leaders deep within Ragefire Chasm. By posing as a willing recruit and bearing the insignias of fallen cultists, you won Fireblade's trust. He revealed more of the network behind his operations.

sections.title: Whispers of the Shadow Council
sections.body: Neeru Fireblade believes you are a loyal lieutenant. He admits that the loss in Ragefire Chasm has set the Searing Blade back, but says the Shadow Council's greater designs remain intact. His masters have active agents in the Barrens and deeper in the forests of Ashenvale. Your report catches Thrall off guard: the demonic conspiracy reaches far beyond the tunnels beneath Orgrimmar.

sections.title: The Warchief's Vigilance
sections.body: Thrall chooses caution instead of executing Neeru at once. Keeping the warlock unaware that his cover is compromised lets the Horde monitor his communications and track the cult across Durotar, the Barrens, and Ashenvale. The Warchief prepares scouts and spies to investigate those branches, seeking to root out demonic corruption without reckless haste.

faq.q: What is the goal of this quest?
faq.answer: Travel from the Cleft of Shadow to the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar and report to Warchief Thrall. Tell him what Neeru Fireblade disclosed about the Shadow Council's plans.

faq.q: Why does Neeru Fireblade trust me?
faq.answer: You recovered a Lieutenant's Insignia from the Burning Blade at Skull Rock and presented it to Neeru as an ambitious cult initiate. He believes you are a loyal asset.

faq.q: Why doesn't Thrall arrest or execute Neeru Fireblade right away?
faq.answer: Thrall can learn more by letting Neeru believe his cover remains intact. The Warchief's scouts can monitor his messages and trace his contacts to larger Shadow Council cells across Kalimdor.

faq.q: What new information does Thrall learn from this report?
faq.answer: Thrall learns that the Shadow Council backs the cult beneath Orgrimmar and has agents plotting operations in the Barrens and the forests of Ashenvale.

faq.q: Is the Burning Blade the same thing as the Searing Blade?
faq.answer: The Searing Blade is a local sect operating in Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar. It serves the wider Burning Blade cult, which the demonic Shadow Council directs.

faq.q: Does this quest chain continue anywhere?
aliases: where does thrall send you next
faq.answer: Thrall tells you to rest and promises to call on you later. No direct continuation of this undercover line follows immediately.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you uncover treason within Orgrimmar's own borders. The young Horde must guard against ancient demonic corruption within while it battles enemies beyond.
As a warlock, you see the danger in Neeru Fireblade's path. Fel practice can slip from sanctioned use into service to the Shadow Council.
As a rogue, you see the Horde's early methods of espionage at work. Deep cover, counterintelligence, and patience take the place of immediate confrontation.
